description: This Java class 'MacroScreenRenderer' implements the 'ScreenStringRenderer' interface to render UI components using FreeMarker templates and macros within the OFBiz framework. It manages macro execution, screen rendering lifecycle, and various widget rendering methods for dynamic UI generation.

classes.name: MacroScreenRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that uses FreeMarker macros to generate dynamic UI components within the OFBiz framework, supporting various widget rendering methods and macro execution.

methods.name: getNextElementId
methods.description: Generates a unique element ID for UI components.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a macro by name with optional parameters, including macro rendering and error handling.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker environment associated with the writer.

methods.name: getRendererName
methods.description: Returns the name of this renderer.

methods.name: renderBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning macro of the screen.

methods.name: renderEnd
methods.description: Renders the ending macro of the screen.

methods.name: renderScreenBegin
methods.description: Pushes the screen onto the stack and executes the macro for screen start.

methods.name: renderScreenEnd
methods.description: Drops the screen from the stack and executes the macro for screen end.

methods.name: renderSectionBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a section, including boundary comments and optional named borders.

methods.name: renderSectionEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a section, including boundary comments and optional named borders.

methods.name: renderContainerBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a container, handling auto-update links.

methods.name: renderContainerEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a container.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label widget.

methods.name: renderHorizontalSeparator
methods.description: Renders a horizontal separator widget.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink widget with parameters, images, and URL handling.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image widget with URL processing based on URL mode.

methods.name: renderContentBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering content, including edit controls.

methods.name: renderContentBody
methods.description: Renders the body of content, fetching from data resources or content workers.

methods.name: renderContentEnd
methods.description: Ends content rendering, including edit links.

methods.name: renderContentFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for simple content display.

methods.name: renderSubContentBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering sub-content with edit controls.

methods.name: renderSubContentBody
methods.description: Renders sub-content, fetching from content workers.

methods.name: renderSubContentEnd
methods.description: Ends sub-content rendering with edit links.

methods.name: renderScreenletBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a screenlet, including title, navigation, and collapsibility.

methods.name: renderScreenletSubWidget
methods.description: Renders a sub-widget within a screenlet, with special handling for navigation forms.

methods.name: renderScreenletEnd
methods.description: Ends rendering a screenlet.

methods.name: renderScreenletPaginateMenu
methods.description: Renders pagination controls for a form within a screenlet.

methods.description: Renders the beginning of a portal page.

methods.name: renderPortalPageEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a portal page.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBody
methods.description: Renders the body of a portal page portlet, loading the screen from location.

methods.name: renderColumnContainer
methods.description: Renders a column container with sub-columns and widgets.
